checks.name: Legacy migration retains rollback bytes and v1 snapshot/export interfaces
Different radios sharing setup profile id are retained across reopen
Repeated identical saves deduplicate without losing older calibrations
Response edits retain the complete radio library
Library backup round trips and merges legacy/v2 imports
Explicit select/remove is bounded and preserves other radios
Independent settings stores merge calibrations saved after they opened
Library count overflow is rejected without discarding saved or session entries
Malformed repeated missing-selected unknown fields and oversize imports are atomic
Failed writes retain session profiles and report quota without touching legacy
Unreadable new library bytes are preserved and block guessed default restoration
Unique connected saved radio restores even when another was last saved
Runtime edits and dirty calibration retain exclusive ownership
Multiple distinct known connected radios require explicit selection
Identical hardware identities at two slots are never guessed
Different calibrations for a single same-model identity remain ambiguous after reload
Metadata-only copies share one calibration for safe restoration
Explicit runtime calibration reconnects uniquely without switching same-model mapping
Saved TX15 calibration suppresses tested fallback and preserves custom direction
Unverified selected mapping does not acquire verified/default ownership
No saved calibration still permits only exact tested TX15 fallback without arming
Legacy store interface and unavailable Gamepad API remain supported
Explicit saved selection survives reload and selects one exact connected device
Sanitized equivalent imports cannot downgrade a locally verified calibration
Different imported calibration stays unverified until an explicit local verified save
Snapshot and library list mutations do not mutate stored data
Response save from a stale view cannot resurrect another view deletion
Concurrent deletion preserves unrelated pending calibrations and explicit reimport
A deleted entry frees full-library capacity for stale views
Quota-failed session additions survive a retry without resurrecting concurrent deletions
A stale legacy reader respects another view migration and deletion

scope: Production profile/store/session/runtime modules and controlled storage/Gamepad samples. No browser, physical-radio acceptance, performance or added unit-suite claim.
